scope: TP2 capacity scratch allocation sharing, exact private-buffer parity, captured graphs and independent lanes. Not throughput or end-to-end serving qualification.
allocation_policy: One data arena per GPU per lane, each owner sized to the maximum required across planned capacities; initialized synchronization counters and LUT/wire allocations remain private. Specializations sharing an arena never overlap.
checks: real layer 0 TP2 weights on both GPUs
all six capacities match separate allocation execution bitwise
descending and ascending graph replay after other capacities overwrite arena
two lanes execute concurrently and survive peer-lane destruction
FP32 rank outputs and BF16 peer sums match independent B12x references at live rows 16/1/3/16/1
other_backends: TP1, Spark and dSpark still use separate capacity buffers in this change.
remaining: extend sharing to other exclusive capacity families
kernel tuning and bottom-up RTX residency
post-optimization adaptive profiles and content acceptance
all requested release benchmarks and quality/quant checks
